description:
We're seeking a drupal developer who work's well within a team environment

 Strong verbal and written communications, Attention to details

 Excellent troubleshooting skills

 Excellent documentation skills

 Ability to meet deadlines on-time

 Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities

 Ability to perform complex Drupal development tasks including custom module development using the Drupal API system and hooks from major Drupal core systems

 
 2 years minimum experience with HTML/XHTML, CSS, and JavaScript
 2 years minimum experience installing, theming, customizing Drupal systems, including Drupal 7.
 3+ years Linux experience
 3+ years Apache experience
 3+ years MySQL or other significant SQL database experience
 3+ years PHP 5 or other significant programming experience
 Knowledge of Section 508 and website accessibility requirements
 Experience in an Agile SCRUM development lifecycle
 Experience designing and coding websites using standards compliant code (ex: W3C)
 

 Nice to Have 
 DKAN and ESRI 
 
 please email word copy of resume to 

 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 

 

 dev@mapjects.com  or jobs@mapjects.com
